title: Meet Your New On-Call Peer: AI-Powered EKS Troubleshooting with AWS DevOps Agent
abstract: When production breaks, standard monitoring isn't enough. SREs waste critical time untangling metrics and IAM policies, while developers struggle to isolate application code issues from infrastructure limits. Join us to discover how the AWS DevOps Agent bridges this gap by shifting from reactive monitoring to autonomous troubleshooting. We will demonstrate real-world scenarios from EKS failures to application layer bottlenecks and show how the agent correlates siloed telemetry data to instantly surface root causes. Learn how to leverage autonomous remediations to slash your MTTR and elevate your team's incident response.

title: EDA at scale? Kafka and OpenTelemetry to the rescue
abstract: We all have seen systems and workloads having bottlenecks at scale especially for the event driven systems. In this talk, we'll cover how Kafka and OpenTelemetry based monitoring can help you scale for the burst load.
